verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs explicitly reference organizations, memberships, and org/tenant-scoped roles (e.g., migration package includes 'users, organizations, memberships, roles' and RBAC roles 'at the organization or tenant level'), and self-serve IT admin onboarding is mentioned, showing multi-tenant B2B modeling out of the box.  However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated invitation flow API or UI for inviting members to organizations. missing for 10: explicit invitation flow documentation/API, hands-on/independent confirmation of the org+membership+invite workflow end-to-end.
